items.briefing:
Privacy advocates are calling on Australian authorities to ban Kmart's smart glasses, citing serious concerns about how the devices collect and handle personal data. Shoppers and staff may not be aware of what information is being gathered, raising questions about consent and compliance with Australian privacy law.

Separately, a study by 1Password has found that AI-generated security patches fail to fix software vulnerabilities around half the time — a reminder that automated tools are not a reliable substitute for proper security review. **Practical tip:** If someone suggests using an AI tool to quickly fix a security issue at your organisation, make sure a qualified person still checks the result before it's applied.

featured.title: Australia urged to ban Kmart smart glasses over privacy
featured.quote: Privacy advocates warn Kmart smart glasses could enable covert filming in Australian retail spaces.
